findings.recommendedAction: Build or use a historical account index; the RPC API has no direct account-list equivalent.

officialSources.note: Official endpoint-mapping table and classic event warning; page last updated 2026-08-18.
RPC is not a Horizon drop-in or historical indexer; recent history window is provider-dependent.

limitations: RPC retains only a bounded recent history window (around seven days by default, provider-dependent).
RPC does not maintain Horizon account-list indexes.
